gloss: to think up; to devise; to come up with

definitions.gloss: to think up; to devise; to come up with
definitions.explanation: To create or produce an idea, plan, or solution through thinking. Emphasizes the emergence of a new idea.

definitions.gloss: to begin to think; to start pondering
definitions.explanation: To start thinking about something. The ～出す suffix marks a sudden or spontaneous onset, unlike ～{始|はじ}める, which simply marks the start of an action. Compare {泣|な}き{出|だ}す (to burst into tears).

examples.japanese: いい{方法|ほうほう}を{考|かんが}え{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To come up with a good method.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{新|あたら}しいアイデアを{考|かんが}え{出|だ}した。
examples.english: He came up with a new idea.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}する{方法|ほうほう}をみんなで{考|かんが}え{出|だ}そう。
examples.english: Let's all come up with a way to solve the problem.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に{将来|しょうらい}のことを{考|かんが}え{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I suddenly started thinking about the future.

examples.japanese: {夜中|よなか}に{目|め}が{覚|さ}めて、{仕事|しごと}のことを{考|かんが}え{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I woke up in the middle of the night and started thinking about work.

examples.japanese: あまり{考|かんが}え{出|だ}すと{止|と}まらなくなる。
examples.english: If you start thinking about it too much, you can't stop.

notes:
A compound verb from {考|かんが}える (to think) + {出|だ}す (to put out / to begin). The two senses correspond to the two meanings of the ～{出|だ}す suffix.

THE TWO MEANINGS OF ～{出|だ}す:
- Producing/extracting: {考|かんが}え{出|だ}す (think something up), {思|おも}い{出|だ}す (recall), {見|み}{出|だ}す (find)
- Beginning: {考|かんが}え{出|だ}す (start thinking), {泣|な}き{出|だ}す (start crying), {走|はし}り{出|だ}す (start running)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アイデアを{考|かんが}え{出|だ}す: to come up with an idea
- {方法|ほうほう}を{考|かんが}え{出|だ}す: to devise a method
- {解決策|かいけつさく}を{考|かんが}え{出|だ}す: to think up a solution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {思|おも}いつく: to hit upon, to come up with — more spontaneous, like a flash of inspiration
- {発案|はつあん}する: to propose, originate — more formal, often used for official proposals
- {工夫|くふう}する: to devise, to figure out — emphasizes creative problem-solving through trial and effort
